reports.notes: Entirely handwritten, in ink, on a photographed (not flat-scanned) page; legible throughout. The candidate signs the Name field 'Renée Tribe' with an acute accent; the summary page's own Name box is written 'Renee Tribe' without it - both transcribed as printed in their own place (candidate_printed keeps the cover page's accented form). Box A's decimal point is written as a comma-like stroke ('1443,54'); transcribed as 1443.54 at medium confidence. FILER ARITHMETIC NOTE, NOT CORRECTED: Box G (2,136.64) equals Box F minus Box E, not Box F minus Box D as the printed label directs (F - D would be 3,883.10). Both boxes are transcribed exactly as written and neither is adjudicated. Office is written 'Utah County Commissioner Seat A', agreeing with index.csv.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = 24,800.00 on the p6 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed as 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report' at the foot of BOTH Schedule A sheets (p2 and p3)
contributions.detail: Schedule A runs across TWO sheets and each sheet prints its own subtotal, so both the per-sheet gate and the grand-total gate were run (the L2 screen). p2: 15 rows sum 3000.00+1000.00+750.00+50.00+500.00+100.00+250.00+400.00+300.00+1000.00+5000.00+2000.00+100.00+250.00+300.00 = 15,000.00 = the printed 'Subtotal for this page $15,000.00'. p3: 8 rows sum 100.00+3500.00+150.00+1500.00+500.00+600.00+3400.00+50.00 = 9,800.00 = the printed 'Subtotal for this page $9,800.00'. 15,000.00 + 9,800.00 = 24,800.00 = the printed Total Contributions Received AND the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B (24,800.00). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 27,990.00 and is NOT summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime). The sum closes ONLY WITH the in-kind row (p2 row 1, Leonard Lee 3,000.00, In-Kind box ticked): monetary-only gives 21,800.00 against a stated 24,800.00, so this filing's stated contribution total INCLUDES in-kind.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 22,360.44 on the p6 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed as 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report' at the foot of BOTH Schedule B sheets (p4 and p5)
expenditures.detail: Schedule B also runs across two sheets, each printing its own subtotal. p4: 8 rows sum 33.42+329.10+800.00+7995.57+3000.00+30.00+80.68+391.40 = 12,660.17 = the printed 'Subtotal for this page $12,660.17'. p5: 15 rows sum 117.86+50.00+2796.62+136.75+535.75+1017.92+10.60+100.00+400.00+75.00+1425.00+573.88+93.74+2250.15+117.00 = 9,700.27 = the printed 'Subtotal for this page $9,700.27'. 12,660.17 + 9,700.27 = 22,360.44 = the printed Total Expenditures Made AND the promoted per-period cell Box D (22,360.44). Box E YTD 24,106.90 is retained as cumulative and never summed. As on the contribution side the closure requires the in-kind row (p4 row 5, Leonard Lee yard signs 3,000.00, In-Kind ticked): monetary-only gives 19,360.44 against a stated 22,360.44.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on BOTH sides — tested both ways per G1. The single in-kind gift (Leonard Lee, yard signs, 3,000.00, 6/20/22) is entered TWICE, once as a contribution (p2 row 1) and once as an offsetting expenditure of the identical amount and date (p4 row 5), each with the In-Kind checkbox ticked, and BOTH stated Column-equivalents (Box B and Box D) include it. Monetary-only fails by exactly 3,000.00 on each side. This is the 2016-Voeks / weber-Bolos pattern recurring; it is a property of THIS filing and was not carried to the filer's other report.
itemized.escalation_note: Two Schedule A amount cells on p3 were escalated to a tight 900 dpi --value crop. (1) p3 row 2 (Narwahl Homes) — the leading digits are written with a bridging horizontal stroke that reads at 200 dpi as a possible strike-out; the 900 dpi crop renders '3500.00' with no strike, and the page's own arithmetic is unique on it (the other seven rows sum to 6,300.00 against a printed subtotal of 9,800.00 once row 6 is settled). (2) p3 row 6 (Lowell Nelson) — the loops read equally as 600.00 or 6000.00 at full page; the 900 dpi crop renders six-zero-zero followed by this filer's comma-form decimal and two zeros, and the arithmetic is decisive and UNIQUE: the seven other rows sum to 9,200.00 against the printed 9,800.00, so the cell is 600.00 (6000.00 would put the sheet 5,400.00 over its own printed subtotal). Arithmetic closure outranks glyph reading (GOTCHAS / Rhodes reversal). No figure was nudged anywhere on this filing; every one of the four printed subtotals and both grand totals reproduce to the cent.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Renée Tribe' (cover Name of Candidate, with the acute accent; she signs the affirmation line 'Renee Tribe' without it, and every schedule footer prints 'Renee Tribe'). index.csv's channel label is 'Renee Tribe' — the page face governs and the accented cover form is recorded here. Page-face office: 'Utah County Commissioner Seat A' (handwritten, two lines).
